items.Sentence: Raw wastewater is pumped to a screw screen (3/8” mesh) that removes the rags and debris.
It then flows to an aerated grit chamber. New grit chamber blowers were installed in 2025.
A grit pump removes the grit from the grit chamber and pumps it into a cyclone separator, which de-waters the grit and deposits it into a dumpster for disposal at a landfill.
Following the grit chamber, the wastewater flows into a new flow equalization basin that has a maximum operating volume of 167,752 gallons.
New VFD blowers and pumps treat and pump wastewater from the equalization basin into the distribution pipes.
RAS from the secondary clarifiers is mixed with wastewater in the splitter box, which then enters the anoxic zone of the activated sludge treatment train.

Each activated sludge treatment train consists of a 96,954-gallon anoxic zone separated by a baffle from a 355,497-gallon aeration basin. ... wastewater moves past the baffle into the aeration basin, where it has an average contact time of 35.3 hours.

Wastewater then flows from the aeration basin to the secondary clarifiers. The sludge floc settles out in the secondary clarifiers and is moved towards the RAS pits by flights (a.k.a. scrapers, plows).
Decanted clarified water flows into one of three treated flow equalization ponds (Pond 1, Pond 2, and Pond 3).

Treated effluent is pumped to the land disposal site, which is located 2.5 miles north of the treatment plant. The treated effluent is pumped to one of three percolation ponds, Pond A, Pond B, and Pond C.
Waste activated sludge is wasted into one of two sludge thickening tanks each with a capacity of 98,337 gallons.
Thickened sludge is then sent to an aerobic digestor before it is pumped to the solids handling system.

The solids handling system consists of a polymer mixing skid where polymer is mixed with water, a floc tank where the polymer-water mixture is mixed with the sludge to create flocs, and a screw press for de-watering the flocked sludge.
Biosolids are hauled away by Synagro West LLC to the Liberty Composting Facility located at 12421 Holloway Road, Lost Hills, California
